title: Block Catalog Manifest
description: Concrete names, outcomes, required states, component dependencies, and data boundaries for all 36 block slots in the Solidiom catalog.

blocks.name: Sign In
blocks.outcome: User can authenticate with email/password or OAuth and reach the authenticated application shell.
blocks.dataBoundary: Authentication service via OAuth 2.0 / OIDC or credential endpoint. No persistent data at rest within the block; session token passed to application shell.

blocks.name: Sign Up
blocks.outcome: New user can register an account with email, password, and optional OAuth, then complete email verification.
states: Error (email already taken, weak password, verification failed, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: User creation service and email delivery service. Temporary verification token; no PII stored within the block.

blocks.name: Reset Password
blocks.outcome: User who has forgotten their password can request a reset link and set a new password.
states: Error (email not found — generic message, expired token, network failure)
Success (password updated, redirect to sign in)
blocks.dataBoundary: Password reset service; time-limited tokens. Block never exposes whether an email exists in the system.

blocks.name: Welcome Wizard
blocks.outcome: New user completes a guided multi-step introduction to the platform's core features and preferences.
states: Completed (all steps finished, redirect to dashboard)
blocks.dataBoundary: User preferences service. Skippable steps; partial progress persisted to resume later.

blocks.name: Profile Setup
blocks.outcome: User configures display name, avatar, bio, and organizational affiliation.
states: Error (upload failure, validation failure, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: User profile service and file storage for avatar. Block reads current user context; writes profile updates.

blocks.name: Project Starter
blocks.outcome: User creates their first project by selecting a template, naming the project, and configuring initial settings.
states: Error (template unavailable, name conflict, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Template catalog service and project creation service. Block reads available templates; creates project resource.

blocks.name: Account Settings
blocks.outcome: User manages profile information, email address, and password from a single settings panel.
states: Error (save failure, validation error, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: User profile and authentication services. Block reads current user data; writes profile and password updates. Email change requires re-verification.

blocks.name: Notification Preferences
blocks.outcome: User configures which notifications they receive via email, push, and in-app channels, organized by category.
blocks.dataBoundary: Notification preferences service. Block reads per-user notification settings; writes updated preferences.

blocks.name: Danger Zone
blocks.outcome: User can deactivate account, request data export, or permanently delete account with explicit confirmation.
states: Error (operation failed, insufficient permissions, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Account lifecycle service and data export service. Block requires re-authentication for destructive actions. Data export is async with status polling.

blocks.name: Subscription Plans
blocks.outcome: User can compare available subscription plans, select a plan, and upgrade or downgrade their subscription.
states: Error (billing service unavailable, payment required, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Billing service for plan catalog and current subscription. Block reads plan metadata and user's active subscription; writes plan changes.

blocks.name: Payment Method
blocks.outcome: User can add, manage, and remove payment methods for their account.
states: Error (payment declined, service error, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Payment processor via tokenization API. Block never stores raw card numbers; relies on payment provider's hosted fields or tokens.

blocks.name: Invoice History
blocks.outcome: User can view, filter, and download past invoices and payment receipts.
blocks.dataBoundary: Billing service invoice endpoint. Read-only block; invoice PDFs served via pre-signed URLs from the billing provider.

blocks.name: Team Management
blocks.outcome: Admin can invite new team members, manage existing members, assign roles, and remove access.
states: Error (invite failed, permission denied, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Team management and invitation services. Block requires admin role; reads team roster; writes invites and membership changes.

blocks.name: Audit Log
blocks.outcome: Admin can review a filterable log of system and user activities with timestamps, actors, and action details.
states: Error (fetch failure, permission denied, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Audit event store. Read-only block; requires admin role. Events are immutable append-only records.

blocks.name: Role Permissions
blocks.outcome: Admin can view and edit role-permission mappings in a matrix interface to control access granularity.
states: Error (save failure, permission conflict, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Role and permission services. Block reads role definitions and permission schema; writes role-permission mappings. Changes take effect on next authentication cycle.

blocks.name: Dashboard Overview
blocks.outcome: User sees a high-level metrics dashboard with charts, key indicators, and trend summaries.
blocks.dataBoundary: Metrics aggregation service. Read-only block; data refreshes on a configurable interval. Time-range selector controls query window.

blocks.name: Real-time Events
blocks.outcome: User monitors a live stream of system events with filtering, search, and pause/resume controls.
states: Error (connection lost, filter error, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Events streaming service via WebSocket or SSE. Read-only block; events are ephemeral unless explicitly saved.

blocks.name: Alert Configuration
blocks.outcome: User creates, edits, and manages alert rules with thresholds, channels, and notification targets.
states: Error (save failure, invalid threshold, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Alert rules service and notification channel registry. Block reads existing rules; creates/updates/deletes alert configurations.

blocks.name: Resource List
blocks.outcome: User can browse, search, filter, and sort a comprehensive list of resources with status indicators.
blocks.dataBoundary: Resource catalog service. Read-only block with bulk selection for downstream actions. Supports server-side pagination and filtering.

blocks.name: Resource Detail
blocks.outcome: User views a single resource's full details, metadata, activity history, and available actions.
states: Error (fetch failure, access denied, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Resource detail service and activity log. Block reads resource data; performs scoped actions (start/stop/delete) with confirmation.

blocks.name: Resource Creator
blocks.outcome: User creates a new resource through a guided multi-step wizard with template selection, configuration, and validation.
states: Error (validation failure, quota exceeded, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Resource creation service and template catalog. Block reads templates and quota; creates resource asynchronously.

blocks.name: Chat Interface
blocks.outcome: User engages in a conversational AI chat with message history, streaming responses, and attachment support.
states: Error (model unavailable, rate limited, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: AI chat service with streaming responses. Block manages conversation state locally; persists messages to chat history service.

blocks.name: Prompt Studio
blocks.outcome: User builds, tests, saves, and organizes AI prompts with variables, templates, and versioning.
states: Error (save failure, test failed, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Prompt storage service and AI execution endpoint. Block reads/writes prompt definitions; executes test prompts against AI service.

blocks.name: Workflow Builder
blocks.outcome: User orchestrates multi-step AI workflows with chained prompts, conditional logic, and external tool integrations.
states: Error (step failure, connection error, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Workflow definition service and execution engine. Block reads/writes workflow definitions; triggers async execution with status polling.

blocks.name: Search Results
blocks.outcome: User performs full-text search across content with faceted filters, result highlighting, and pagination.
states: Empty (no query entered, no results match)
blocks.dataBoundary: Search index service. Read-only block; query and filter parameters passed to search API. Results include snippet and metadata.

blocks.name: Saved Searches
blocks.outcome: User saves frequent search queries, sets up alert notifications for new matches, and manages saved search collections.
blocks.dataBoundary: Saved search storage and alert notification service. Block reads/writes saved queries; manages alert subscriptions.

blocks.name: Search Analytics
blocks.outcome: User views search usage statistics including popular queries, zero-result rates, and search behavior trends.
blocks.dataBoundary: Search analytics aggregation service. Read-only block; aggregates anonymized search metrics. No individual query content exposed.

blocks.name: Product Catalog
blocks.outcome: User browses a product catalog with grid/list views, category filtering, sorting, and product detail previews.
blocks.dataBoundary: Product catalog service. Read-only block; product images served via CDN. Price and availability cached with TTL.

blocks.name: Shopping Cart
blocks.outcome: User manages cart items with quantity adjustments, coupon application, and checkout initiation.
states: Error (item unavailable, coupon invalid, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Cart service and pricing service. Block reads cart state; updates quantities and coupons. Checkout transitions to billing flow.

blocks.name: Order Tracking
blocks.outcome: User views order status, tracking information, delivery timeline, and order history.
blocks.dataBoundary: Order management and shipping tracking services. Read-only block; tracking data polled from carrier APIs.

blocks.name: Content Editor
blocks.outcome: User creates and edits rich content with a WYSIWYG or markdown editor, formatting toolbar, and preview.
states: Error (save failure, conflict detected, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Content storage service. Block reads document content; writes incremental saves with conflict detection.

blocks.name: Content Library
blocks.outcome: User manages a library of content assets including documents, images, and files with search, folders, and metadata.
states: Error (fetch failure, upload failed, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Asset storage and metadata service. Block reads asset listing; supports upload and deletion with confirmation.

blocks.name: Content Workflow
blocks.outcome: User manages content through a draft-review-publish pipeline with status tracking, assignments, and approval gates.
states: Error (transition failed, permission denied, network failure)
blocks.dataBoundary: Content workflow and approval services. Block reads pipeline state; transitions items between stages with permission checks.

blocks.name: Navigation Layout
blocks.outcome: User navigates the application via a responsive sidebar with collapsible menu sections, breadcrumbs, and current-route highlighting.
states: Mobile-overlay (sidebar as overlay on small screens)
blocks.dataBoundary: Navigation configuration service and user permissions. Block reads menu structure; highlights active route. Sidebar state persisted in local storage.

blocks.name: Command Palette
blocks.outcome: User accesses a global keyboard-driven command menu for quick navigation, search, and action execution.
blocks.dataBoundary: Command registry service. Block reads available commands scoped to user permissions; executes actions via command handlers.

blocks.name: Notifications Center
blocks.outcome: User views, manages, and dismisses notifications from a unified panel with categorization, read/unread states, and mark-all-read.
blocks.dataBoundary: Notification service with real-time updates. Block reads notification feed; writes read/dismiss states. Supports WebSocket push for new notifications.
